query:
SELECT tr.projectId, tr.id, tr.roundType, tr.status, tr.finishedAt, tr.createdAt
FROM test_rounds tr
WHERE tr.projectId IN (180001, 150001, 120001)
ORDER BY tr.projectId DESC, tr.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
